artists.biography:
Matthew Charles "Matt" Berry (born 2 May 1974) is an English actor, writer, comedian and musician. Berry is perhaps best known for his appearances in The IT Crowd, Garth Marenghi's Darkplace, The Mighty Boosh, and Snuff Box. He is renowned for his deep voice; he has voiced several advertisements, most notably for Volvic, The Natural Confectionery Company, Absolute Radio, and MoneySupermarket.

As a musician, Berry composed all the music for Snuff Box, as well as the music for AD/BC: A Rock Opera, which he co-wrote with Richard Ayoade. AD/BC was a half-hour parody of overblown musicals in general and Jesus Christ Superstar in particular, telling the story of the innkeeper who allowed Mary, Joseph, and the baby Jesus to sleep in his manger. AD/BC was broadcast in December 2004 and featured Fulcher and Mighty Boosh stars Julian Barratt and Noel Fielding. He also performed a song for an episode of Garth Marenghi's Darkplace entitled "One Track Lover", a spoof of cheesy romantic 80s songs.

perplexity.description:
Everything's Peachy" by the Matt Berry Trio is the second volume in Acid Jazz Records' "The Jazz Sessions" series, released on June 26, 2026, as a remarkable 12-part instrumental suite that marks an exciting leftward turn for Matt Berry. Joining long-time collaborators Phill Scragg and Graham Mann, Berry takes a break from his usual songwriting to explore his deep jazz, modern classical, and electronic influences. The album is a cohesive work that showcases the trio's versatility, moving away from Berry's typical comedic rock style into a more sophisticated and atmospheric jazz realm.

The suite is inspired by the story of Richard "Beebo" Russell, an American folk hero known as "the Sky King," who famously stole a large aircraft with no flight training, performed stunts, and crashed to his own demise; the album's title derives from Russell's response to air traffic control during the incident. Released on black vinyl, with an Acid Jazz-exclusive "Opaque Spring Green" color vinyl limited to 500 copies, as well as CD and digital formats, "Everything's Peachy" stands as a significant and unique entry in Berry's catalog, offering listeners a remarkable 12-part journey through his diverse musical inspirations.
